label: Fed policy probabilities
description: Fetch FOMC meeting policy probabilities from an institutional proxy JSON endpoint (optional Vault base_url). Language-neutral fields; marks under-anchored futures backup when primary is blocked.

description_i18n.en: Fetch FOMC meeting policy probabilities from an institutional proxy JSON endpoint (optional Vault base_url). Language-neutral fields; marks under-anchored futures backup when primary is blocked.
description_i18n.zh_CN: 从机构代理 JSON 端点拉取 FOMC 政策概率（可选 Vault base_url）。字段语言中立；主源失败时可标记 under-anchored 的期货后备。
description_i18n.zh_HK: 從機構代理 JSON 端點拉取 FOMC 政策概率（可選 Vault base_url）。欄位語言中立；主源失敗時可標記 under-anchored 的期貨後備。

propose_guide: BEST WHEN: NL needs Fed hike/hold probabilities with as_of. Prefer this over news snippets for rate odds. If public proxy is blocked (403), Owner should Vault-bind a reachable base_url mirror. Optional allow_futures_backup uses Yahoo ZQ=F as secondary under-anchored hint — never treat as primary meeting odds. Prediction markets belong in polymarket/sentiment (sentiment only). Output is language-neutral.
